query:
with f as(select unnest(array['2e316843-95a9-46a2-bbc5-e603669d5878','d088a8dc-d17d-40a5-b1ef-39fc697844d4','1ef0fd33-bd83-4ddf-b8a5-eb1150e69584','37ed7a81-4191-46ef-a595-e4e1bbb0e4a5','428199a3-9df3-485c-aa04-b038a3254bc9','2c74344d-7a85-4f4c-b5cf-aa43d2880903','c172206d-fa3f-4e54-a28c-4df23a62a2e5','03b7ffb3-4fa5-4fb5-83c5-98434381c6a6','f1734e88-9d01-47b4-b511-b911cab3b460','b77be19b-9b1f-41b1-871e-2cdffd171c45','12d1a975-2c74-4ff0-987b-44f708e3625a']::uuid[]) id), e as(select unnest(array['de-3fbd3fa4ce19abd6b0d80716ed9ecad7']::text[]) id union select distinct t.id from public.debate_v3_events t join f on t.owner_id=f.id::text or t.state->'members' ? f.id::text), counts as(
select 'auth_users' scope,count(*) n from auth.users t join f on t.id=f.id
union all select 'auth_sessions' scope,count(*) n from auth.sessions t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'refresh_tokens' scope,count(*) n from auth.refresh_tokens t join f on t.user_id=f.id::text
union all select 'identities' scope,count(*) n from auth.identities t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'student_roles' scope,count(*) n from public.user_roles t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'roles_assigned' scope,count(*) n from public.user_roles t join f on t.assigned_by=f.id
union all select 'registry' scope,count(*) n from private.internal_test_accounts t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'profiles' scope,count(*) n from public.profiles t join f on t.id=f.id
union all select 'forum_profiles' scope,count(*) n from public.forum_profile_settings t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'debate_events',count(*) from public.debate_v3_events t where t.id in(select id from e)
union all select 'debate_receipts',count(*) from public.debate_v3_receipts t where t.actor_id in(select id::text from f) or t.event_id in(select id from e)
union all select 'debate_audit',count(*) from public.debate_v3_audit t where t.actor_id in(select id::text from f) or t.event_id in(select id from e)
union all select 'debate_ballots',count(*) from public.debate_v3_ballots t where t.judge_id in(select id::text from f) or t.event_id in(select id from e)
union all select 'debate_votes',count(*) from public.debate_v3_votes t where t.actor_id in(select id::text from f) or t.event_id in(select id from e)
union all select 'debate_outbox',count(*) from public.debate_v3_outbox t where t.actor_id in(select id::text from f) or t.event_id in(select id from e)
union all select 'debate_uploads',count(*) from public.debate_v3_uploads t where t.actor_id in(select id::text from f) or t.event_id in(select id from e)
union all select 'debate_match_versions',count(*) from public.debate_v3_match_versions where event_id in(select id from e)
union all select 'debate_rate_limits',count(*) from public.debate_v3_rate_limits t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text
union all select 'storage_owned',count(*) from storage.objects t where exists(select 1 from f where t.owner=f.id or t.owner_id=f.id::text or position(f.id::text in t.name)>0) or (t.bucket_id='debate-private-v3' and exists(select 1 from e where starts_with(t.name,'evidence/'||e.id||'/') or starts_with(t.name,'exports/'||e.id||'/')))) select clock_timestamp() checked_at,(select count(*) from f) fixture_count,jsonb_object_agg(scope,n) counts from counts;
scopeCaveat: Explicit artifact-recorded event IDs are included even if their parent rows are deleted. All eight related actor/event scopes and exact debate-private-v3 evidence/<eventId>/ and exports/<eventId>/ prefixes are checked. This independent SELECT proves scoped database absence at its timestamp; it does not independently exercise old-bearer HTTP denial, diagnose the prior upload exception, prove successful upload, physical media, mail, timers or full acceptance.
